title: Strategic thread mapping and commitment calendar for company OKR alignment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a repeatable 'Strategic Thread Matrix' and a shared Commitment Calendar that maps company-level OKRs to initiative owners, cross-functional milestones, and release windows. Problem: current OKR roll-up is ambiguous — teams surface progress but there is not a single canonical mapping of which initiatives deliver which KRs, nor a calendar of commitments that product, eng, and design can use to sequence work and reduce blocked handoffs. This ticket scopes the work needed to (1) define the mapping format and gating criteria, (2) prototype tooling templates (spreadsheet + Redwood Console dashboard spec) and (3) run a pilot across infra, runtime, and console teams for Q1 cadence. Success measures: canonical matrix published, 3 pilot teams adopt calendar, measurable reduction in cross-team dependency incidents for targeted initiatives (baseline -> 30% reduction), and alignment score of >=80% from stakeholders in post-pilot survey.
acceptance_criteria: Strategic Thread Matrix template (CSV + Google Sheet) published in Confluence with fields: Initiative, Owner, Primary KR(s), Dependencies, Release Window, Blockers, Risk Level, Success Metric, Rollout Plan
Commitment Calendar populated for all company-level initiatives for Q1 with owners and milestone dates
Pilot adoption by infra/runtime/console teams with weekly syncs recorded for 6 weeks
Dashboard spec filed for Redwood Console showing per-initiative progress (tokens served, latency, cost delta) and linked to each KR
Stakeholder alignment survey >=80% positive on clarity of who owns deliverables and timelines
decisions: Use a single canonical Google Sheet as the source-of-truth for the pilot to reduce tooling friction
Adopt a three-tier gating model: Green (on-track), Amber (at-risk; escalation), Red (blocked; executive notification)
Map each company-level KR to no more than 3 primary initiatives to minimize diffuse ownership
tasks: Draft Strategic Thread Matrix template and example rows (owner: Marco) - due 2026-02-02
Run a 30-minute kickoff with pilot teams and SRE/product leads - due 2026-02-05 (owner: Aisha)
Populate Commitment Calendar for pilot initiatives (owner: initiative leads) - due 2026-02-12
Define gating thresholds and escalation path with GTM and Eng managers (owner: Priya Desai) - due 2026-02-18
Create Redwood Console dashboard spec and PRD stub to instrument OKR metrics (owner: Jamal Reed) - due 2026-02-22
Run first retrospective after 4 weekly syncs and capture learnings (owner: Marco) - due 2026-03-01
risks: Ambiguity in initiative boundaries leading to duplicated work or missed dependencies
Tooling fatigue if we introduce another tracking surface without immediate value
Stakeholder bandwidth: execs may not attend escalation touchpoints causing stale risk signals
mitigations: Keep initial pilot low-friction: single sheet + short weekly 30-min syncs
Automate a portion of the dashboard metrics via existing telemetry — scope to essential KR signals first
Define a lightweight escalation owner rota (1-week coverage) so exec notifications are handled predictably
